analysis:
The supplied units are base-side text of CHANGELOG.md (historical entries, lines 1649-2242). The patch excerpt shows the only change is documentation: the v0.10.0 candidate heading is replaced by a v0.10.1 candidate heading plus rollout notes at head lines 11-138. No source, crypto, authorization or configuration code changes. The visible head patch is truncated, so only the first ~8 added lines of rollout notes were seen.

Base-side content is historical release notes covering App Attest, prefix-cache SSD checkpoints (T-041), the provider/coordinator wire contract and Qwen4 work. These entries are unchanged and are not new behaviour, so I raised no pre-existing issues.

The visible rollout notes refer to coordinator logprob refusal (darkbloom-platform#411), the mlx-swift-lm pin bump (7bed8216 to 6148b6da), and page-cache accounting that may count more memory as available. The page-cache memory-accounting change could affect admission and availability (T-029, T-016 class). It is described only in a truncated changelog note, with no code visible, so I cannot assess it. The logprobs 500 `generation_failure` cooling every provider of a model is a coordinator-side availability dependency, and the note documents it as requiring the platform-owned fix.

Open questions for integration: whether the code changes behind these notes, which are not in this batch, keep the load-admission and KV-budget safeguards, and whether the libs/mlx-swift-lm bump alters native inference or cache identity. Remaining notes in head lines 11-138 were not visible. No threat-model update appears required from this documentation-only change.
